plugin.note: Skeletons are undead, so a Salve amulet (or Salve amulet (ei)) boosts every hit. They are weakest to crush (crush -5) and fall quickly to any melee weapon such as a Dragon scimitar; earth spells exploit their 35% earth weakness for Magic training. Krystilia's task must be done in the Wilderness with risk-appropriate gear.

requirements: No Slayer level is required to receive a Skeletons task.
Krystilia's skeletons must be killed in the Wilderness (e.g. the Graveyard of Shadows).
mechanics: Skeletons attack with crush melee for up to 3 damage at a 4-tick speed.
They are undead: the Salve amulet applies and they have a 35% earth spell weakness.
Their crush defensive bonus is negative (-5), so crush weapons hit most accurately.

methods.label: Melee (Salve)
methods.summary: Wear a Salve amulet and clear skeletons with any melee weapon; crush weapons are most accurate.
requiredOrKeyItems: Any melee weapon (Dragon scimitar or a crush weapon)
steps: Equip a Salve amulet for the undead damage boost.
For starter masters, kill skeletons in the Edgeville Dungeon or Varrock Sewers.
For Krystilia, kill Wilderness skeletons at the Graveyard of Shadows with risk-appropriate gear.

methods.label: Wilderness (Krystilia) safe kit
methods.summary: Complete the Krystilia task in the low-level Wilderness with cheap, risk-appropriate gear to minimise PKer loss.
requiredOrKeyItems: Cheap melee weapon and armour you can afford to lose
steps: Bank valuables; wear only risk-appropriate gear before entering the Wilderness.
Kill skeletons at the Graveyard of Shadows; they die in one or two hits.
Watch the minimap for PKers and teleport out when threatened.

body:
# Skeletons

Skeletons are a low-level Slayer task assigned by Krystilia, Turael, Spria, and Mazchna. They are undead, so a Salve amulet boosts every hit; they are weakest to crush (crush -5) and carry a 35% earth spell weakness. Any melee weapon clears them quickly. Starter-master tasks are fastest in the Edgeville Dungeon or Varrock Sewers; Krystilia's task must be done in the low-level Wilderness at the Graveyard of Shadows with risk-appropriate gear.
